# Buzzsprout Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill that manages podcast episodes on Buzzsprout: list and fetch episodes, create, update, or delete them, and list embed players. Confirm before every create, update, or delete — name the show, episode title, and what will change; no exceptions. `--podcast-id` is required on every command: double-check it matches the intended show before any write. Uses a Buzzsprout API token (Settings), kept in Muse's secure vault. Buzzsprout has a free plan. Draft: written from Buzzsprout's public API docs, not yet live-tested end-to-end — this listing's unverified status reflects that. No secrets in the repo.
